title: Sample Industrial Venture I distribution notice (Example Gateway Industrial Park sale)

evidence.quote: Sample Industrial Venture I will make a distribution on July 15, 2026.

fields.value: Sale of Example Gateway Industrial Park

evidence.quote: The distribution is the net proceeds of the sale of Example Gateway Industrial Park, which closed on June 30, 2026.
The distribution is allocated between Example Pension Fund and the Sponsor Member under the distribution provisions of the joint venture agreement.
